title: Region-Aware Multi-View Inspection Using Deep Learning and Domain-Informed Decision Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.29398v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated optical inspection of precision components with tiny surface defects remains challenging when different regions of the same component exhibit different defect characteristics and, therefore, different acceptance criteria. This paper presents a region-aware, dual-model inspection framework that combines instance segmentation of localized seat-region defects with image-level classification of global shaft-region anomalies. Rather than treating these two model detections as sufficient evidence for component rejection, a deterministic decision fusion layer that formalizes industrial Standard Operating Procedures is applied to the model outputs to make the final component level decision. A PLC-synchronized imaging system acquires 18 seat and 18 shaft images over a full 360-degree rotation to provide multi-view circumferential coverage. The framework was evaluated on 380 automotive fuel injector needles, covering representative ope

translated_title: 基于深度学习与领域知识驱动决策融合的区域感知多视角检测
translated_abstract: 当同一精密部件的不同区域表现出不同的缺陷特征、因而需要不同的验收标准时，对具有微小表面缺陷的精密部件进行自动化光学检测仍然极具挑战性。本文提出了一种区域感知的双模型检测框架，将针对局部座圈区域缺陷的实例分割与针对整体轴区域异常的图像级分类相结合。这两种模型的检测结果并不被视为足以直接判定部件报废的证据，而是在模型输出之上应用一个形式化了工业标准作业程序的确定性决策融合层，以做出最终的部件级判定。系统采用PLC同步的成像装置，在360度完整旋转过程中采集18张座圈图像和18张轴部图像，以提供多视角的周向覆盖。该框架在380根汽车喷油器针阀上进行了评估，覆盖了具有代表性的工况条件。
tldr: 该论文提出一种区域感知的双模型检测框架，将座圈区域缺陷的实例分割与轴区域异常的图像分类相结合，并通过形式化工业标准作业程序的确定性决策融合层，对360度旋转采集的多视角图像检测结果进行融合，实现精密部件的部件级自动判定。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a region-aware dual-model inspection framework that combines instance segmentation of seat-region defects with image-level classification of shaft-region anomalies, applying a deterministic decision fusion layer encoding industrial SOPs to multi-view images captured over a 360-degree rotation to make final component-level decisions.
